name: Prawn and Harissa Spaghetti
method: Boil the broccoli florets in lightly salted water for 2 minutes until tender, then lift out and set aside. Cook the spaghetti in the same water following the pack instructions, then drain, keeping a ladleful of the cooking water.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan, add the bashed garlic and fry over a low heat for 2 minutes, then remove the garlic and discard it.
Add the tomatoes to the pan and fry over a medium heat for 5 minutes until soft and juicy. Stir in the prawns and heat them through for 2 minutes.
Add the harissa and the lemon zest and stir to coat.
Toss the spaghetti, a splash of the pasta water and the broccoli through the prawns. Season and serve.
